cwilso/PitchDetect
https://github.com/cwilso/PitchDetect
pin: 13cb49e51dde5e52464d354410216cb4c2e87a7e
MIT, Copyright (c) 2014 Chris Wilson

Upstream holds a live getUserMedia stream and runs autocorrelation every
animation frame. GifOS never hands an app a live mic. vendor/pitch.js is
the ACF2+ detector, noteFromPitch, and centsOffFromPitch as a classic
script. The app records a short take with gifos.recordAudio, then names
the pitch. Honest UI: "Record a note". Last reading stays in the file.
